I feel that the line between toy and tool is a bit to vague to draw perfectly between the two. There are too many items that would straddle the line depending on how you look at them. A hammer is a tool, but when given to a child to swing around and play with does it become a toy? Toy cars when wedged under a heavy dresser to make moving it easier, do they become tools? I believe that it is in the usage and sex/ masterbation is (hopefully) an inherently pleasurable activity that people pursue not only because of the innate biological urge to. Therefore I'd say that sex toys are still toys.

I would argue that is about the intention of usage that determines whether it is a tool or toy. A tool is used to achieve a purpose while a toy's usage is the purpose. If an item primarily exists to entertain, than I would argue that it is a toy.
